name: Bambowl
tagline: Recipes, meal plans and grocery lists, tidy and in one place.
description: Bambowl keeps your recipes, cookbooks, weekly meal plan and grocery list on your phone. Save a recipe from a website, a video or a photo of a cookbook page, and Bambowl reads it into clean ingredients and steps.
Sign in with Google if you want your recipes on more than one phone. Everything else stays on the phone.
features: Import recipes from links (recipe sites, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) or photos
Cooking mode with step timers and hands-free voice control
Weekly meal plan and a smart grocery list
"What can I cook?" from what you already have
Optional AI tidy-up for messy recipe text

dataSafety.deletion: In the app: Account › Google account › Delete my account. Or email us.
extras: Works without an account. Nothing is collected until you sign in.
No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

releases.notes: Cook hands-free: Bambowl reads each step aloud and moves on when you say "next".
changes: Tap the microphone in cooking mode to switch hands-free on
Finished timers are announced, so you hear them across the kitchen
Choose the reading voice and its speed in Preferences › Cooking voice
Optional "Hear me from further away" for a busy kitchen
It only listens while cooking mode is open, and nothing you say is recorded

releases.notes: Updates now download and install right inside the app, and you see what's new after each update.
changes: Tap Update and Bambowl downloads the new version itself, with a progress bar
Every download is checked before Android asks you to install it
If anything goes wrong, the download opens in your browser as before
After an update, a short "What's new" note appears once. Read it again any time in Help & about
